summary: Round 1: 8/9 findings resolved; 1 minor cosmetic remains (subdomain certbot phrasing tightened in Risks). Round 2 introduces 3 new minor mirages around SQL helper naming (`search_attestations` and `ensure_schema` functions are invented — actual names are `search` and ad-hoc `execute_batch(SCHEMA)`), and 1 minor about the existing `governor = "0.8"` dep in mcp/Cargo.toml not being acknowledged when adding `tower_governor`. No critical issues. Pinned crate versions are all realistic.

findings.claim: tech-spec line 117: '`recall` SQL query in `core/src/storage/sqlite.rs::search_attestations` adds a mandatory `WHERE owner_pubkey = ?` clause' (also Decision 9 line 97, Risks line 212 'SQL helper function `search_attestations(owner_pubkey, query, limit)`')
findings.reality: No function named `search_attestations` exists in `core/src/storage/`. The actual cosine-search implementation is `fn search(&self, query_embedding, signer, limit)` in both `core/src/storage/traits.rs:50` (trait) and `core/src/storage/sqlite.rs:212` (impl). The current parameter name is `signer: &str`, not `owner_pubkey`.
findings.source: tech-spec.md Data Models (line 117), Decision 9 (line 97), Risks table (line 212)
findings.fix: Rename to the actual function (`AttestationStore::search` / `SqliteStore::search`) or explicitly state the function will be renamed/extended as part of Task 4. Either way, align all three references.

findings.claim: tech-spec line 115: 'Schema migrations — both run idempotently on first connection in `core/src/storage/sqlite.rs::ensure_schema`'
findings.reality: There is no `ensure_schema` function in `core/src/storage/sqlite.rs`. Schema is initialized inline via `conn.execute_batch(SCHEMA)` inside `SqliteStore::open` (line 127) and `SqliteStore::in_memory` (line 138), and a separate `migrate_payment_events_unique_index(&conn)` helper runs the only existing migration. Task 4 will need to either add an `ensure_schema` function or extend the existing inline `execute_batch` calls.
findings.fix: Replace `core/src/storage/sqlite.rs::ensure_schema` with an accurate description, e.g. 'extend the existing `SqliteStore::open`/`in_memory` schema-init blocks with two idempotent ADD COLUMN migrations alongside `migrate_payment_events_unique_index`'. Or commit to creating a new `ensure_schema` helper in Task 4 and say so explicitly.

findings.claim: tech-spec line 130: 'tower_governor = "=0.4.2" (pinned) — per-IP rate limiting on `/mcp` (Decision 9)' is added as a NEW package; existing deps (line 149) list `tower-http (incl. cors feature)` but not `governor`
findings.reality: `mcp/Cargo.toml:20` already includes `governor = "0.8"` with the comment 'Rate limiting (POST /chat: 10 req/min per IP)'. The new `tower_governor` crate is an Axum/Tower middleware layer that depends on `governor`. The spec doesn't acknowledge the existing `governor` dep or whether it stays / is upgraded.
findings.fix: Note that `governor = "0.8"` is already present in `mcp/Cargo.toml:20` and used by an existing rate limiter. Either reuse it directly (skip `tower_governor`) or document that `tower_governor` brings its own pinned `governor` and explain whether the existing one stays. Verify version compatibility — `tower_governor 0.4.x` typically requires `governor 0.6` or `0.7`, not `0.8`.

findings.claim: tech-spec line 119: '`save_attestation` (in `core/src/storage/sqlite.rs:149-182`) signature gains a non-optional `owner_pubkey: &str` parameter'
findings.reality: `save_attestation` impl is at lines 150-182 (off-by-one) and the trait definition is in `core/src/storage/traits.rs:33-44`. Adding a parameter requires modifying BOTH (trait + impl). The spec only mentions sqlite.rs.
findings.fix: Update line numbers to `core/src/storage/sqlite.rs:150-182` and explicitly mention the trait `AttestationStore::save_attestation` in `core/src/storage/traits.rs` must also gain the parameter.
